description: PRE-FLIGHT ECB FX & SLIPPAGE GATEKEEPER. Cross-checks a stated currency pair, nominal exchange rate, and transaction amount against the official European Central Bank Daily Reference FX feed (eurofxref-daily.xml) and returns verifiable slippage bounds with a signed XDR-1 receipt.

base_currency.description: Source ISO 4217 currency (e.g., EUR, GBP, USD)

max_slippage_bps.description: Maximum permitted slippage in basis points (default 50)

quote_currency.description: Target ISO 4217 currency (e.g., USD, PLN, INR)

stated_rate.description: Proposed exchange rate to verify against ECB reference

name: attest_fx_and_slippage
